verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Stripe publishes an official CLI (docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli), a first-party tool from the same vendor whose Treasury resources are exposed through the Stripe API. However, the evidence never shows the CLI covering Treasury objects such as FinancialAccounts, OutboundPayments or Transactions, and it says nothing about AI-native or agent-oriented CLI workflows. missing for 10: evidence that the CLI supports Treasury resources and money movement, documentation of AI/agent-oriented CLI usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
